description: FREE for a key holder, counts as one call against the key's daily quota. GET /v1/verdicts/report: the verdicts requested with PREDGE_KEY in one UTC month (optionally one merchant_id): counts by outcome, refund recommendations (count, total USD), top reason codes, median/p95 time to verdict, verdict ids with verify URLs (paginated, next_cursor), a sample and the methodology. Signed; the tool re-checks the signature. Params: month (YYYY-MM), merchant_id, limit (1-1000, default 100), cursor, sample (0-20, default 5).
name: predge_verdict_report
title: Monthly signed dispute-handling report (needs PREDGE_KEY)
